175.news_title: 21inch 1600x1200 Aspect Ratio with Native 15khz Support LCD Monitor
175.long_description: Our new release 21.3inch LCD monitor with 4x3 1600x1200 aspect ratio, offered higher brightness, higher contrast, and multiple options for digital display, desktop monitor, and 15khz native support for arcade and retro users. Boost your desktop performance. A 1600×1200 display gives you more room to read, write, and code without constant scrolling. Whether you’re working on documents, browsing long articles, or editing spreadsheets, that added height makes a noticeable difference in comfort and efficiency. Many of our arcade customers have decided to use their 4x3 1600x1200 aspect ratio to handle their word, excel and video editing projects. We have significantly increased the performance from our flagship 20inch 1600x1200 monitor. Our 21.3inch LCD monitor offers; - 500nits brightness (up from 300nits with 20inch) - 1800:1 contrast (up from 800:1 with our 20inch) - RGB, VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort (RGB, VGA and HDMI only supported with our 20inch) For our arcade and retro gaming customers, Arcooda monitors offer low display lag, 15khz native input with multiple mounting options. Its the high standard for your smaller footprint.
